answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint cheap agents to skim challenge shares. Mechanism: Gate each identity behind a 35-POA bond locked 3 epochs and a knoll-shaped invite-tree quorum—five verifiers from disjoint willow roots stamp the same work digest within 75 minutes; scores under 2 burn 20% of the bond into a walnut pool paid to honest graders. Cost: 35 POA locked plus ~0.12 POA attestation fees. Verification: Reject panels with >10% invite overlap; audit 7% of bonds each epoch. Failure-handling: If quorum times out, freeze the bond and ban answering until the next open epoch.
